title: Merging & filtering pipeline parameters
description: Merges the LowPass GENCOVE and Axiom genotype datasets, filters samples/variants, and produces per-phenotype GWAS-ready PLINK datasets.

gencove_bfile_prefix.description: Path prefix (no extension) of 01_mapping's merged LowPass PLINK dataset (DA_IMP_GENCOVE_ALLCHR).

axiom_bfile_prefix.description: Path prefix (no extension) of 2_Axiom_imputation's merged, imputed PLINK dataset (DA_AFFYimp_ALLCHR).

fam_qc3modi.description: Frozen fam file with both sampleID and dogID columns (DA_MERGED_GENCOVE_AXIOM_QC3modi.fam).

exclude_list_round2.description: Frozen, manually-curated second-round KING relatedness exclusion list (list_exclude_secondexclusion.txt).

dogid_relabel_fam.description: Frozen, manually-prepared sampleID -> dogID crosswalk fam file (modi_DA_MERGED_GENCOVE_AXIOM_QC4C_forDogIDchange.fam).

fam_2584dogs.description: Frozen, manually-decided final ALLFAM sample-set fam file (fam_2584dogs.txt).

data6.description: Frozen data1+factor-score+item checkpoint (data6_2024-10-14.txt) consumed as-is rather than recomputed — see the pipeline README's Stage E notes.

exclude_list_lowpass12.description: 12 LowPass samples with no Darwin's Ark dogID and no phenotypes (exclude_12_LowPass_samples.txt, data/01_mapping), removed in RELABEL_AND_EXCLUDE_ROUND3.

size_pheno_file.description: Darwin's Ark's own SIZE control phenotype (data/02_data_processing/Q121A.pheno). Not part of this pipeline's original sources — see data/04_gwas/getSIZE_pheno_genofiles.r and process_definitions.nf's SIZE section header.
